purpose: small development diagnosis of one +55 mm Ours localization failure and a center control; no ranking or formal test claim

existing_history_ols.rule: centered least-squares slope over valid network positions

robust_pairwise_median.rule: component-wise median of all causal pairwise position slopes

inference_contract.voxel: causal five x 5 ms x 2 polarity x 64 x 64 count tensor, log1p before network
inference_contract.network_height: fixed target-center plane from the shared scene configuration
inference_contract.gt_usage: only after inference, for offline position/velocity/TTC errors

scope: Two old development episodes only. No retraining, generator ranking, control rollout, or formal test claim.
